title: Database crash during checkpoint
alert: The shop homepage loads, but any page needing the database shows 'Service unavailable'. The database container is stopped.

truth.root_cause: A data page checksum failure during a checkpoint triggered a PostgreSQL PANIC. Automatic recovery attempted but failed because the corrupted page is in a critical system catalog, leaving the database process exited and unable to start.
truth.fix: The database must be restored from a clean backup or the corrupted cluster re-initialized. Since no backup job exists, the only action an engineer can take with the available tools is to restart the container and hope recovery succeeds this time; if it does not, the instance requires manual pg_resetwal or a full restore from outside the toolset.
